name: food_ordering_app
description: Production-Ready Full-Stack Food Ordering Platform with Real-Time Tracking

scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd .. && rm -rf dist && cp -r frontend/dist ./dist
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.vercel-build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && rm -rf dist && cp -r frontend/dist ./dist
